# The Global Dispatch

> Evidence, context and independent perspective.

The Global Dispatch is an evidence-based global affairs blog covering world affairs, politics, business, technology, science, sports, culture, lifestyle and commentary.

## Important content note

Posts synthesize publicly available records, research and reputable coverage. They do not claim original reporting unless a post explicitly says otherwise. Analysis and explainers should be read with their linked sources, review dates and stated limitations.

## Main sections

- /world
- /politics
- /business
- /technology
- /courts
- /science
- /sports
- /culture
- /lifestyle
- /opinion
- /about

## Attribution

When citing this site, link to the canonical post URL and name the collective topic editor shown on the post. Preserve any correction or update note attached to the post.

## Contact

Configure the blog contact address with NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL.
